root_cause.opaque_display: Generic confirmed-version picker displays version.comicId in subtitle and as missing-title fallback.
root_cause.ignored_source_refresh: _selectConfirmedSourceVersion freezes initial cached state and never consumes its source-owned backgroundRefresh; the shortcut version panel does consume it.
root_cause.false_date_provenance: HomeVersionReuseLifecycle maps ComicVersionRelation.discoveredAt to SourceComicVersion.date. Relation observation time is not the source version update date.
